name: Bug report
about: Something on the site broke or didn't work as you expected.
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug

**What happened?**
What you did and what went wrong.

**Where?**
Which page (`/`, `/v1a`, `/v2`, `/flat`, `/heavy`, `/drowning`, `/dangerous`, `/hotlines`, or `/404`) and on what device (phone / desktop, OS, browser + version).

**What did you expect?**
What you thought would happen instead.

**Anything else worth knowing?**
Screenshots, console errors, network tab — whatever helps reproduce it.
